cdb.label: CDB R4
cdb.method: Last saved legal queryall projection, learn=0, at or before the R4 cut.
cdb.archive_note: Parsed projections and response hashes; complete original HTTP bodies are not included.

sf.label: Stockfish
sf.method: Baseline: unrestricted MultiPV 3 at all 100 positions. Decision comparisons use their own completed same-depth MultiPV rounds.

decisions.title: A dated DCC example
decisions.lesson: Only three of 47 moves had scores in the original DCC example. Later analysis did not preserve Bxa4 as a unique best choice.

decisions.title: The right rook for the plan
decisions.lesson: Support b7 with the e-rook while keeping the a-rook available. The separate SF comparison supports this idea.

decisions.title: A good candidate set, a weaker choice
decisions.lesson: Rb8 abandons the defence of c4 and allows Bxc4. This is a different position from the successful 20...Reb8 idea.

decisions.title: Look beyond the pawn moves
decisions.lesson: The quiet Rf8 belongs in the candidate set. Both natural f-pawn moves concede more in the saved SF search.

decisions.title: Take the tempo first
decisions.lesson: Nc4 attacks Qd2 with tempo. The later Qc7 in the game is played after the queen has moved.

decisions.title: The better capture was already seen
decisions.lesson: BD had Rxe5 in the list. The missed step was ranking the candidates, rather than finding the rook capture.

decisions.title: Check the opponent's strongest reply
decisions.lesson: After Nxa5, Bb6 attacks both Qc7 and Na5. Qxa5 removes the queen from c7 and leaves Nc4 controlling b6.

decisions.title: A queen move with tempo
decisions.lesson: Qa5 attacks Qa2 while Nc4 supports the queen. This was revealed by GPT and cannot count as a blind BD decision.

decisions.title: One knight, two targets
decisions.lesson: Na3 attacks Qb5 and Rb1 at once. BD found the move before evaluation and Kasparov played it.

decisions.title: The queen tempo makes the capture work
decisions.lesson: Ra8 attacks Qa6 and removes the rook from c8. After the queen moves, Nxb1 becomes safe; immediate captures fail.

decisions.title: A useful plan one move earlier
decisions.lesson: The saved SF comparison supports h5 after 41.Kh2. Kasparov's later h5 follows 42.Rb6, from a different position.

decisions.title: A concrete mating continuation
decisions.lesson: R4 raw 29973 means 27 plies. A separate SF d34 search reports M14 and its saved legal line ends in Qh2#.
